events.label: The Bell Beneath the Water
events.description: A drowned battlefield bell tolls once beneath black water. Pale soldiers turn their faces toward the sound.

events.label: The Cut Ferry Rope
events.description: A ferry rope has been sliced cleanly and bootprints vanish into reeds on both banks.

events.label: The Bloated Track
events.description: Something too heavy for a natural beast dragged itself through the mud, leaving venom-bright saliva in its wake.

events.label: Blackbanner Encampment — Drowned Verge
events.description: Jack’s Blackbanner bandits have fortified a patch of dry ground with scavenged timber, iron hooks, and watchfires.

events.label: Reedline Ambush — Drowned Verge
events.description: A snapped reed is the only warning before Blackbanner raiders rise from concealed firing positions.

events.label: The Dead Reform — Drowned Verge
events.description: Mud-caked soldiers pull themselves from an old battle line and resume a war that ended long ago.

events.label: The Fog Remembers — Drowned Verge
events.description: The fog thickens until the battlefield overlays the present, and a mass of wandering spirits turns toward the living.

events.label: Mira’s Runoff — Drowned Verge
events.description: A swollen creature bearing stitched scars and witch-burn brands lunges from poisoned water.

events.label: Candle in the Fen — Drowned Verge
events.description: A lesser witch has hung corpse-lanterns from dead branches and is waiting beneath them.

events.label: Broken Truce — Drowned Verge
events.description: Bandits drive cursed dead and mutated beasts ahead of them, turning the path into a three-sided killing ground.
